Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a volume of 19890 pcs per year at a price of €32.20 per unit. The requested contract term is 12 months, and our Lieferzeit is 54 days. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard commercial procedure upon receipt of your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH team,

Your capacity updates link additional allocation directly to firm commitment—it sounds like dependable demand is what you need to reserve capacity with confidence. We are ready to make a long-term commitment if you can secure our full requirement, giving both sides a dependable basis for planning. How can we turn that certainty into a firm allocation and a sustainable commercial agreement?

We confirm a binding volume of 23,400 units per year for 36 months. Our should-cost estimate for Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM is EUR 24.31 per 1 (cost:340010). Our orders for Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM were at EUR 28.94 until December 2023 and have been at EUR 29.89 since January 2024 (po:4500010364-10, po:4500010407-10, po:4500014436-10). Your on-time delivery over the last 12 months was 79.5% (sc:70410@2026Q3). We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 29.57 per unit, 23,400 units a year, 36 months, 56 days lead time). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €31.50 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We have reviewed your historical pricing data and delivery records.
Given our current capacity constraints, we must maintain a firm position on pricing.
We accept your proposed volume of 23,400 units and 36-month contract duration, and offer a revised price of EUR 31.50 per unit.
Our Lieferzeit is 56 days.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH team,

You have accepted our long-term commitment while continuing to emphasise capacity constraints; it sounds like planning certainty matters as much as protecting your margin. We want that commitment to support stable production for you and dependable allocation for us. How can we turn that certainty and the latest verified cost movements into a sustainable agreement that secures the full committed volume?

We confirm a binding volume of 23,400 units per year for 36 months. Labour cost index DE, manufacturing, seasonally and calendar adjusted (quarterly, carried to its three months) changed -0.3% from 2025-10 to 2026-01 (idx:LCI-C@2025-10, idx:LCI-C@2026-01).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 30.11 per unit, 23,400 units a year, 36 months, 56 days lead time). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,
We acknowledge receipt of your message.
This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.
Our terms: a price of €31.30 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months.
For the record:
We have verified the minor decrease in the labor cost index and incorporated it into our revised offer.
Given our high capacity utilization, securing your full allocation requires a sustainable price level.
We propose a price of EUR 31.30 per unit for the requested volume and 36-month contract duration.
Which volume can you commit to?
Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.
Our Lieferzeit is 56 days.
These are our standard conditions for this product.
We will process your next message according to our standard procedure.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
